overview_description.description:
Adfin develops payment and revenue collection infrastructure designed to help businesses automate how they get paid. The company provides a platform that combines invoicing, payment acceptance, reconciliation, and credit control into a single system. It supports multiple payment methods including cards, bank transfers, direct debit, and account-to-account payments through integrated banking rails and payment partners.

The platform includes automation tools that handle payment reminders, failed payment retries, and customer communication across email, SMS, and messaging channels. It also offers AI-driven credit control features that help businesses track invoices, manage receivables, and reduce manual follow-ups. Adfin integrates with accounting and finance software to synchronize transactions and automate reconciliation processes.

The company’s infrastructure is designed for businesses that want to streamline accounts receivable workflows and centralize payment operations. Its system focuses on improving cash flow visibility, reducing manual finance work, and consolidating payment processes into one digital workflow.

about_short_description.short_description: Adfin is a fintech company that develops an agentic money movement platform to automate and accelerate how businesses get paid.

product.name: Adfin Payment Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that automates invoicing, payment collection, and reconciliation for businesses, integrating with accounting software like Xero and QuickBooks.

product.name: Direct Debit Payment Service
product.description: A direct debit solution that enables businesses to collect recurring payments with automated mandate management, retries, and fallback to card payments if direct debit fails.

product.name: Invoice and Payment Link Management
product.description: A tool to create, upload, and send invoices or payment links in various formats, with automatic syncing to accounting software and customizable branding.

product.name: Credit Control Dashboard
product.description: A centralized dashboard that tracks invoice statuses, payment collections, and credit control activities, syncing automatically with accounting software.

product.name: Adfin Accountants & Bookkeepers Club (ABC)
product.description: A partner program offering accountants and bookkeepers access to discounted rates, training, client data insights, and co-marketing resources to support client payment management.
